breakage_notes: All 5 concurrent jobs used unique uuid4-based sbx- names: no collisions detected. Simulated sandbox avoids Celesto Cloud rate limits (free tier: 1 retained sandbox). On real Cloud, concurrent runs would require a paid top-up or the local Firecracker runtime. ThreadPoolExecutor kept resource usage flat; no shared state between sandboxes. Watched for: name collisions (none), shared file state (none), DB contention (none, upsert schema).
